interface.longDescription: Plugin Skill Builder helps create ChatGPT-ready skills-only plugin packages. It defines the plugin purpose, creates valid skill folders, writes SKILL.md files, checks package shape, validates manifests and assets, and prepares a ZIP for testing or upload.
capabilities: Design a skills-only ChatGPT/Codex plugin from a reusable workflow.
Write valid SKILL.md instructions with trigger-oriented metadata.
Validate plugin shape and prepare a ZIP package for testing or upload.
interface.defaultPrompt: Create a ChatGPT-ready plugin skill from this workflow.
